source_checks.comparison: These exact selected body lines were re-read for recording, corroborating the earlier reviewer. This is template/background support, not a verified four-node EI0006 fix. No template execution, interface guess, system write or blanket timeout increase was adopted.

source_checks.claim: Selected implementation lines17-29 set HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT default600 and HCCL_IF_BASE_PORT default21000 in a different world-model launcher.
source_checks.comparison: Exact selected code was re-read; it provides another-model configuration example, not evidence that changing these variables fixes this environment. Current connect120 and no inferred NIC-subset setting were retained.

source_checks.claim: The previous single-instance16-rank FP32 scalar AllReduce passed with HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1, CONNECT_TIMEOUT120 and EXEC_TIMEOUT180.
source_checks.comparison: Full evidence was read. It argues against declaring INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1 categorically invalid. It does not establish four-node AllGather success, a current fault locus, or model accuracy.
